newsitem.title: USA: ICF Kaiser sees "major growth cycle".
newsitem.headline: ICF Kaiser sees "major growth cycle".

text.p: ICF Kaiser International Inc said Tuesday it believes it has several large projects in scope and believes it is beginning a major growth cycle.
The company said its contract backlog exceeds $4.5 billion.
Earlier Tuesday the company reported nil earnings per share in the second quarter, down from $0.05 in the 1996 second quarter.
It attributed the drop to the completion of a large management contract at the Department of Energy's Hanford Site in Richland, Washington, which ended October 1, 1996.

"Our backlog excluding the Hanford or Rocky Flats project reached $1.9 billion on June 30, the highest ever and more than one-quarter billion dollars higher than a year earlier," the company said. "With several additional large projects in our scope, we believe we are beginning a major growth cycle."
